3. Direction: If I'm not doing something correctly, how can I do things differently?

I know a number of barista who, even though they are quite accomplished at it, have put the latte art fad in their rear view mirror.  The amount of milk one needs to make a suitable foundation for latte art absolutely ruins an otherwise good cup of coffee (IMHO and in the opinion of many baristas whom I trust). In fact, in most of the latte art competitions I have viewed, the judges don’t even taste the coffee.  The quality of my coffee is not secondary to an acceptable rosetta!  A well brewed macchiato with but a dollop of milk is as far as I will push a milk coffee.  For what it is worth, if you steam a 1/1 mixture of coffee to ice, you can get a foam suitable for creating coffee art without destroying the cup itself.
